```
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let dashes be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let mutable lines: List of Text be [render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths), render_row(cells: dashes, widths: widths)]
  for each row in table.rows
    set lines to lines.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end
  return lines.join("\n")
end
```

```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let dashes be
    for each width in widths
    collect "-".repeat(width)
  let body be
    for each row in table.rows
    collect render_row(cells: row, widths: widths)
  let top be [
    render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths),
    render_row(cells: dashes, widths: widths)
  ]
  let newline be "\n"
  return top.append_all(body).join(newline)
end
```

```renyi
public function render(table: Table) returns Text
  purpose: The table as Markdown, every column padded to its widest cell.
  tags: markdown, formatting
  example: render(Table(header: ["name", "qty"], rows: [["apple", "1"], ["kiwi", "12"]])) is """
    | name  | qty |
    | ----- | --- |
    | apple | 1   |
    | kiwi  | 12  |
    """

  let widths be column_widths(table)
  let separator be " | "
  let dashes be for each width in widths collect "-".repeat(width)
  let mutable output_lines: List of Text be []
  set output_lines to output_lines.append(render_row(cells: table.header, widths: widths))
  set output_lines to output_lines.append("| {dashes.join(separator)} |")
  for each row in table.rows
    set output_lines to output_lines.append(render_row(cells: row, widths: widths))
  end
  return output_lines.join("\n")
end
```
